argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='E:\work\video2-r25-local'
$run='E:\work\video2-r25-local-run'
if((git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne 'b11a93664f9b64bf6da626119758c841a0a75c1e'){ throw 'HEAD drift' }
if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((git -C $repo status --porcelain) -join ''))){ throw 'repo dirty' }
$script=@'
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
Set-Location "E:\work\video2-r25-local"
$log = "E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused2.log"
$exitFile = "E:\work\video2-r25-local-run\focused2.exit"
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $exitFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& npm run test:r25 *> $log
$code = $LASTEXITCODE
Set-Content -LiteralPath $exitFile -Value ([string]$code) -Encoding Ascii
exit $code
'@
$scriptPath=Join-Path $run 'focused2.ps1'
Set-Content -LiteralPath $scriptPath -Value $script -Encoding UTF8
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$scriptPath) -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
[pscustomobject]@{pid=$p.Id;script=$scriptPath;exit=(Join-Path $run 'focused2.exit');log=(Join-Path $run 'focused2.log')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
